source: Cox, S. C., Smith Lyttle, B., Elkind, S., Smith Siddoway, C. S., Morin, P., Capponi, G., et al., 2023. The GeoMAP (v.2022-08) continent-wide detailed geological dataset of Antarctica. PANGAEA, doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.951482. Described in: A continent-wide detailed geological map dataset of Antarctica, Scientific Data 10, 250, doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02152-9. CC BY 4.0.
method: GeoMAP geological units by simplified class (SIMPCODE), grouped by age; drawn at 0.5 km and kept at 2 km (each pixel: its most common class, and the share of it that is rock as alpha) over the section grid in the block's along/across km (scripts/geology_geomap.py). Moraine, other unconsolidated deposits, ice and unclassified rock are left out. Present-day outcrop, carried with plate 802.

name.en: Precambrian shield basement (mainly Archean gneiss, granulite)
